comparisonHistory.method: Reused the dated 2026-10-31 comparison where applicable and searched additional primary supplier pages/photos. Five suppliers is a first-round target, not a claim that five originals were downloaded for every product. Page-only and failed downloads are not photo approvals.
comparisonHistory.pb-radius-tooling: ALAS, Yafei, TSD, BHT, Fabmax, Infinity compared previously. Old Yafei CAD and cropped BHT promotional photo rejected; selected a different Yafei actual assembly photo Z6.jpg.
comparisonHistory.pb-u-forming: Gunnar, BHT, Yafei, Shinite, HARSLE, UKB considered; roller tools and CAD rejected, some originals unavailable. Selected full Shinite 3024px fixed U-channel lower die photo.
comparisonHistory.pb-embossing: Yafei CAD/offset photo rejected; UKB and Metalmaq originals unavailable, Eurostamp original timed out after retry. Xinmechan actual flanging assembly selected at 800x571; high-resolution replacement outstanding.
comparisonHistory.pb-container: Sarin front-panel actual tool selected; Sarin side-panel alternative downloaded, Shinite small photo, UKB page-only, Yafei CAD rejected. Metalmaq wine-container closure tools rejected as a different application; five comparable actual originals were not obtained.
comparisonHistory.pb-light-pole: Two distinct useful supplier sources: CMC low-resolution photo and hydraulic-press-brake.com tooling photos. Most other results were whole machines or reposts, not counted as independent suppliers. Selected complete pair; cropped rack variant rejected.
comparisonHistory.sk-foil: Goodter, Sollex, Sparkquill, Sundi, Hexin and Multech considered. Renders/promotional graphics, whole slitting assemblies and low-resolution photos rejected; Ingol returned 406 and Ferrotec original unavailable. Multech actual blade group selected; native 800px limitation retained.
comparisonHistory.sr-casting: Apex, Shinite, AMK, ALAS and SENDA compared; ASKO process evidence also consulted. Mixed rolling blade groups and scrap choppers rejected. Selected Shinite billet flying-shear pair; exact continuous-caster station compatibility is not established by this photo.
comparisonHistory.cp-thin-slitter: DOMA, Shen Gong, Yafei, Kinki Hamono and Huatao compared. Selected Kinki actual annular blade with six mounting holes; brand/cloth background removed in edited version.
comparisonHistory.cr-rotor/cr-stationary: Signature, Khosla, Yafei, Sureay, GL Knife and additional suppliers considered in earlier research. Selected GL Knife 1500px originals after successful download; ACE bed-knife product page corroborates stationary identity. Failed KN/EDGE/Mastercut/Kamadur downloads are not approvals.
